description:

author: GameSpot
description:
Having now played about two hours of Gears of War: E-Day, I'm not impressed. 

The upcoming third-person cover shooter handles fine and the demo I played through checked all the hits you'd expect from the genre--intense action, cringy one-liners, lots of blood, a desperate gamble to cross a bridge while being peppered by sniper fire. But of what I've seen, it seems like E-Day misses the mark that all prequels should try to hit.

#gearsofwar #eday #campaign #gaming #preview #impressions #earlygameplay

description:
Step into Bowerstone, the bustling capital of Albion, and discover a world where every person has a life of their own, every choice has consequences, and every Hero leaves their mark.

In this extended gameplay demo, explore a living city filled with stories to uncover, homes and businesses to own, reputations to build, and adventures waiting around every corner. From shaping your appearance and growing a family to making difficult choices and mastering combat, the path you take is entirely your own.

Fable launches February 23, 2027.
